summary: Candidate a8546b8 is a narrow, verified follow-up to round-2 feedback: it disambiguates the `hybrid.test.tsx` "Start free" query to the header banner and strengthens it into a real interaction assertion (click → sign-in dialog opens), and appends an honest status update to docs/HYBRID_UI_MIGRATION.md. I ran the fix directly (`vitest run src/components/hybrid/hybrid.test.tsx`, plus `appDesign.test.ts`, `hybridContrast.test.ts`, `landing.test.tsx`, `shared.test.tsx`) — all pass. I also ran the full web suite (`npx vitest run`, 106 files / 1284 tests, includes PR4–PR8 and apps/web/src) and `tsc --noEmit` — both clean, contradicting the builder's inconclusive "spawn EPERM" report but not indicating any defect (the environment issue was local to the builder's sandbox, not a code problem). Reviewed the underlying round-1/2 hybrid implementation (App.tsx, DesignProvider, useAppDesign/appDesign, HybridNav, HybridHeroIntro, HybridReportsSection, Hero.tsx branch, AIVerdictBlock.tsx, hybrid-tokens.css): all changes are presentational, gated behind `data-design='hybrid'`, do not touch calculations/entitlements/routes/business logic, do not add italic/glow decoration, and match the mapping doc's claims. The docs candidly state this is a homepage/foundation increment, not a completed migration, and lists concrete remaining work — consistent with the brief's requirement not to claim completion for a partial increment. No protected paths, commits-by-builder, deploys, or destructive actions occurred. Diff is fully within the builder's lane.
